about: Where the Rust camera-mount reconciler answers a case of the TS golden (camera-mount.json, dumped from reconcileCameraMount @89b5c64) differently BY DESIGN since Phase 1 of the support-other-camera-models plan. crates/xorgate-agent/tests/camera_mount.rs runs every TS case: a field named here (state, logs, applies, file) must equal THIS value and must differ from the TS value; every such field not named here must equal the TS value. `probes` is judged apart: the TS probes `dtoverlay -h` before each write (probes: ["imx290"]); the Rust reconciler asks only for an overlay outside the sensor catalog (D96), so its probes are [] unless a case names them here.

rows.D95: the Rust agent calls xorgate-camcfg, not xorgate-camrotate
rows.D96: the sensor catalog, not the dtoverlay -h probe, says whether a catalog overlay can rotate
rows.D98: 0 is written as an explicit rotation=0, never as a dropped token
rows.D99: a camera line under a [section] is edited only when the section is known to apply to this board
rows.D100: two camera lines on one port: nothing is edited
rows.D115: a rejection reaches the journal once per change; a write back to the rotation in force says no reboot is needed

refuses to edit a sensor whose overlay h.why: the fixture's probe says `no rotation parameter` for imx290; the catalog says imx290 can flip, and the probe is not asked

logs.msg: cam0: imx290/cam0 rotation set to 180° in <dir>/config.txt — REBOOT required before the image changes (the agent never reboots itself)

# Raspberry Pi config
camera_auto_detect=0
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
[cm4]
otg_mode=1
[cm5]
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host
[all]
dtoverlay=imx290,cam0,4lane,rotation=180
dtoverlay=imx290,cam1
#dtoverlay=googlevoicehat-soundcard
